injection_details.target_discovery: Process snapshot enumeration via CreateToolhelp32Snapshot, Process32First, and Process32Next looking for explorer.exe (falls back to GetCurrentProcessId if not found)
injection_details.method: Manual Mapping / PE Injection via NtWriteVirtualMemory and CreateRemoteThread
injection_details.payload_writing: VirtualAllocEx + NtWriteVirtualMemory (writes PE header, section data, and applies base relocations)

encryption_details.key_storage: Hardcoded ASCII string stored in .rdata section at image offset 0x5000 (VA 0x140005000)

anti_analysis: Debugger / analysis tool detection via GetModuleHandleA('dbghelp.dll') and GetProcAddress('SymSetOptions')
Delayed execution / anti-sandbox timing delay via Sleep(30000) if analysis environment is detected
